_about: A stylised road scheme, used to put a road project through the same appraisal as the rail line. It is ILLUSTRATIVE: it is not an LTA proposal, and whether a lane could be added on this alignment was not examined. Same labels as config/model.json.

rule.value: the named road with the most directed km above a volume/capacity ratio of 1.0 in the 2030 do-minimum assignment
rule.label: ASSUMPTION
rule.note: results/road_scheme_corridor_ranking.csv lists the candidates; a test checks that the road named below is the one the rule picks from the committed flows

threshold_vc.label: ASSUMPTION
threshold_vc.note: a link counts as over capacity above this ratio

road_name.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
road_name.note: OpenStreetMap name of the corridor picked by the rule

highway.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
highway.note: main carriageway only; slip roads are left as they are

direction.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
direction.note: links whose end node lies south of their start node. In the AM peak hour every over-capacity link of this road is southbound, towards the Central Area

added_lanes.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
added_lanes.note: one more lane on every selected link; capacity rises by the model's per-lane capacity for the road class, free-flow time is unchanged

name.label: ASSUMPTION
name.note: compared with dm_2030: the same 2030 land use (Tengah built), no Jurong Region Line, the same car demand matrix

demand.label: ASSUMPTION
demand.note: the model's mode choice uses free-flow car times and its distribution uses distance, so faster roads do not create, redistribute or attract trips from public transport. Only routes change. A first-round mode response is reported for scale but not fed back

warm_start.label: ASSUMPTION
warm_start.note: starting point of the with-scheme assignment; the equilibrium does not depend on it, only the path of the iterations

capital_cost_pv_sgd_million.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
capital_cost_pv_sgd_million.note: round placeholder, present value in the base year; no source. Every ratio that uses it is illustrative

operating_cost_sgd_million_per_year.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
operating_cost_sgd_million_per_year.note: round placeholder for maintenance of the added lane, constant in real terms from the opening year; no source
